reference.license: MIT (code). Photos belong to the original author, not reused.
reference.original_stack: React 19, Vite, GSAP (ScrollTrigger, Draggable), Lenis smooth scroll
reference.this_build_stack: Plain HTML, CSS, JS. GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Draggable and Lenis loaded from CDN. No build step.
reference.overall_feel: Warm, friendly, scrapbook style single-page portfolio. Soft curved section edges, hand-drawn squiggle underlines that draw in on scroll, sticker and polaroid details, lots of small motion.

fonts.body: Plus Jakarta Sans (paragraphs, labels, notes, chips)
fonts.note: Reference used a third handwritten font (Caveat) for notes. Replaced with Outfit italic so only two fonts are used.

type_scale_uniform.rule: Only five sizes exist on the whole site. Every section reuses them.

shapes.section_edges: SVG wave on the top edge of each section, filled with that section's background

sections.name: Loader
sections.motion: Avatar pops in with elastic scale, bubble pops after, bar fills. On load, items shrink out and the overlay slides up off screen, then the page unlocks scrolling.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.layout: Floating pill bar at the top, centered, max 1200px wide.
content: Left: round avatar + lowercase name with accent dot
Center: links About, Work, Journey, Toolbox, Milestones
sections.mobile: Links collapse into a burger button that expands a sheet with large links plus Contact.
sections.motion: Slides down after the loader. Hover shows a small dot under each link. Links smooth-scroll to sections.

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Two columns. Left copy, right visual. Fills the first screen.

left: Very large name with a squiggle underline
Row of 3 quick stats split by a top border
Two buttons: "See my work" (filled) and "Message me" (outline)
right: Organic blob shape in blush with a small rose circle
Cut-out portrait placeholder sitting on the blob
Rotated note: "move your cursor, I'll look at it!" with a hand-drawn arrow

sections.motion: Name letters rise in one by one, squiggle draws, copy fades up, blob and portrait pop in. Portrait leans toward the cursor (reference swaps head-turn video frames; this build tilts a single placeholder). Visual has slight scroll parallax.

sections.name: About
sections.layout: Two columns. Left photo stack, right copy.

left: Fanned stack of 4 photo cards, each with caption "I'm a" + role
Hint: "click to see my other roles"
right: H2 "A little about me" with squiggle
2x2 grid of stat cards (big number + label)

sections.motion: Clicking the stack flings the top card out and back to the bottom. Cards and stats rise in on scroll.

sections.name: Selected work
sections.layout: Header then 3 cards in a row (1 column on tablet and mobile).
content: Note "scroll to tidy up the table"
Each card: browser-window frame with 3 dots and fake URL, project image, number badge, tag, title, short text, tech chips, "View project" link
sections.motion: Cards start scattered and rotated, then settle into a tidy row as you scroll (scrubbed).

sections.name: Journey
sections.layout: Centered header, then a vertical timeline. Items alternate photo-left / card-right.
content: Each item: taped polaroid with handwritten caption, center dot, card with year, title, organization, short text
sections.motion: A dashed winding road links the dots. A solid line draws over it as you scroll and a small avatar travels along it. Polaroids and cards slide in.

sections.name: Toolbox
sections.layout: Header with note and Shuffle button on the right, then a dotted board.
content: Board of skill stickers in 4 tones (rose, white, blush, ink)
sections.motion: Stickers pop in, can be dragged anywhere inside the board, and Shuffle rearranges them with an elastic bounce.

sections.name: Milestones
sections.layout: Centered header, 4-column certificate wall, then a second header and 4-column numbers row.
content: Each frame: logo badge, certificate title, issuer, round check seal
Each number: big value with suffix, accent line, label, note
sections.motion: Frames drop in slightly rotated and straighten on hover. Numbers roll into place like an odometer, lines draw underneath.

sections.name: Contact + footer
sections.layout: Large rose card, two columns: copy left, cut-out sticker right.
content: Buttons: Send an email, GitHub, LinkedIn
Cut-out portrait placeholder with bubble "say hi!"
sections.motion: Card rises in, sticker pops up and gently sways, bubble pops. Copy button shows "Copied" for 2 seconds.

images.rule: All images are local SVG placeholders in img/. Swap with real photos using the same file names.

files.img/avatar.svg: square, round avatar (loader, nav, journey walker)
